args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export missing first run
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Fix the issue where a weekly scheduled export created early in the day does not send on the same day. Adjust the calculation of the first run date to ensure the export triggers on the expected first scheduled Monday rather than the following one, addressing the off-by-one scheduling problem reported by users.
